column6: User logged in; navigate to a case with zero payment schedules
column8: 1. Navigate to the case detail page for a case with no payment schedules. 2. Verify the "Add Payment Schedule" empty-state CTA is visible. 3. Click the "Add Payment Schedule" empty-state CTA. 4. Verify the modal is visible. 5. Verify the modal title element is visible.
column9: 1. Case detail page loads. 2. Empty-state CTA is visible. 3. CTA is clicked. 4. Modal opens. 5. Modal title "Add Payment Schedule" and subtitle "Define the expected payment timing and method for a payer. Payments are not initiated from this schedule." are displayed.

column6: User logged in; navigate to a case with an existing payment schedule row
column8: 1. Navigate to the case detail page for a case with an existing schedule. 2. Verify the "Add Payment Schedule" button is visible in the populated view. 3. Click the button. 4. Verify the modal is visible.
column9: 1. Case detail page loads with a populated schedule table. 2. Button is visible. 3. Button is clicked. 4. Modal opens with correct title/subtitle.

column5: Closing modal without saving discards no schedule
column6: Case with an existing schedule row; modal open
column8: 1. Note the current schedule row count. 2. Open the modal via the populated-view button. 3. Close the modal without filling/saving. 4. Verify modal is no longer visible. 5. Verify row count is unchanged.
column9: 1. Row count captured. 2. Modal opens. 3. Modal closes. 4. Modal hidden. 5. Row count matches pre-close count.

column5: Payer dropdown shows only eligible payers
column6: Modal open; at least one payer flagged "Allow Payment Schedule" and one not flagged
column8: 1. Open the Payer dropdown. 2. Verify the eligible payer option is visible. 3. Verify the ineligible payer option is NOT present.
column9: 1. Dropdown opens. 2. Eligible payer listed. 3. Ineligible payer absent from the list.

column5: Existing-schedule payer is disabled with tooltip
column6: Case has a payer that already has a schedule
column8: 1. Open the Payer dropdown. 2. Verify the payer-with-existing-schedule option is disabled. 3. Hover the disabled option. 4. Read the tooltip text.
column9: 1. Dropdown opens. 2. Option shown but disabled. 3. Tooltip appears on hover. 4. Tooltip reads "A payment schedule already exists for this payer."

column5: No eligible payers results in empty dropdown / Save stays disabled
column6: Case with zero payers flagged "Allow Payment Schedule"
column8: 1. Open modal from empty-state CTA. 2. Open the Payer dropdown. 3. Verify the Save button remains disabled.
column9: 1. Modal opens. 2. Dropdown opens with no eligible options. 3. Save button disabled.

column5: "Specific day of the month" reveals day selector
column7: Schedule Type = "Specific day of the month"
column8: 1. Select an eligible payer. 2. Select "Specific day of the month" as Schedule Type. 3. Verify the day selector is visible. 4. Verify the weekday pattern selector is NOT visible.
column9: 1. Payer selected. 2. Schedule Type set. 3. Day selector shown. 4. Weekday selector hidden.

column8: 1. Select an eligible payer. 2. Select "Relative weekday" as Schedule Type. 3. Verify the weekday pattern selector is visible. 4. Verify the day selector is NOT visible.
column9: 1. Payer selected. 2. Schedule Type set. 3. Weekday selector shown. 4. Day selector hidden.

column5: All Payment Method options are selectable
column7: ACH, Credit Card, Direct Deposit, Personal Check, Other
column8: 1. Select an eligible payer. 2. Open the Payment Method dropdown. 3. Verify each of the 5 expected options is present.
column9: 1. Payer selected. 2. Dropdown opens. 3. ACH, Credit Card, Direct Deposit, Personal Check, and Other are all listed.

column5: Auto-Pay checkbox toggles and shows helper text
column8: 1. Verify the Auto-Pay helper text "Indicates whether this payer is set up for auto-pay." is visible. 2. Click the Auto-Pay checkbox to check it. 3. Verify checkbox is checked. 4. Click again to uncheck. 5. Verify checkbox is unchecked.
column9: 1. Helper text visible. 2. Checkbox clicked. 3. Checkbox checked. 4. Checkbox clicked again. 5. Checkbox unchecked.

column5: Save button disabled until all required fields complete
column7: Payer, Schedule Type "Specific day of the month" + day 15, Payment Method "ACH", Auto-Pay
column8: 1. Verify Save disabled with no fields filled. 2. Select payer; verify Save still disabled. 3. Select schedule type + day; verify Save still disabled. 4. Select payment method; verify Save still disabled. 5. Set Auto-Pay status; verify Save becomes enabled.
column9: 1. Save disabled. 2. Still disabled. 3. Still disabled. 4. Still disabled. 5. Save becomes enabled only once every required field is set.

column5: Save shows success toast and updates table
column6: Modal open; all required fields fillable
column7: Payer, "Specific day of the month" + day 15, "ACH", Auto-Pay on
column8: 1. Note current schedule row count. 2. Fill all required fields. 3. Click Save. 4. Verify modal closes. 5. Verify row count increased by 1. 6. Verify success toast is visible.
column9: 1. Row count captured. 2. Fields filled. 3. Save clicked. 4. Modal closes. 5. New row appears. 6. Toast reads "Payment schedule added successfully."

column5: Duplicate schedule prevented for same payer
column6: Case has a payer with an existing schedule
column8: 1. Open the Payer dropdown. 2. Verify the payer with an existing schedule cannot be selected (disabled).
column9: 1. Dropdown opens. 2. Option is disabled, preventing a second schedule for that payer/case pair.

column5: Viewer role cannot access Add Payment Schedule
column6: Logged in as a Viewer-role user; case with existing schedule
column8: 1. Navigate to the case detail page as a Viewer. 2. Verify the "Add Payment Schedule" entry point is hidden or disabled.
column9: 1. Page loads. 2. Entry point is either not rendered or rendered but disabled — Viewer cannot create a schedule.
